text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr gave it her all, feeling 
like she truly became the wind during the 
race. But at the same time, she believes 
she can become even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And spotting a banner in the stands 
reading "Zephyr's Spirit," she vowed to 
become an even greater wind with the help 
of her cheering fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the Winning Live, she said that 
everything began when she met the "Emperor 
of the Mile" in this place. And so—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've decided on the mile race, the Yasuda 
Kinen, as my next goal. Surpassing the 
"Emperor of Miles" and capturing "Three 
Distance Titles"— it all starts right 
here.
